articles.title: Tech leads D-Street bound, FPI play in focus
articles.description: On Friday, Indian equities bounced back, driven predominantly by a surge in technology stocks. Investors showed renewed interest in undervalued IT shares, aided by a decline in crude oil prices. After a prolonged period of selling, foreign investors reversed their trend, becoming net buyers in July and August. Broader market indices also benefited from this trend, as mid and small-cap stocks appreciated.

articles.title: Trump calls Venezuela oil agreement ‘biggest deal in world history’, says it will cut US gas prices
articles.description: The US and Venezuela have entered an oil agreement that President Donald Trump has called the “biggest oil deal in world history”, giving Washington majority control over more than 65 billion barrels of proven Venezuelan crude reserves. Trump said the deal would more than double US oil reserves, boost supply, lower gasoline prices and support Venezuela’s economic recovery.
